eu_number_source.rule: Union Register open dataset (ods_products.json, Creative Commons Attribution 4.0): rows with Type Human carry EUNumber, the product page URI (html/h{n}.htm) and EMALink, the EMA EPAR page. An EMA product is mapped through its medicine_url equal to EMALink (case-insensitive, trailing slash and scheme ignored); when no EMALink matches, through an exact normalised product name, ignoring a trailing '(previously ...)' note, among Human rows (preferring Active rows; recorded as a name match). The h-page of every reference product is then fetched and its EMA number (dataSet_proc ema_number) and EU number (dataSet_product_information) are checked against the mapping.
